listing.name: The Last Guardian (The Last Guardian — native PC port)
listing.summary: Upstream route: Upstream runtime package for The Last Guardian — native PC port; use own game files per documented setup, with upstream/player owning installation and runtime replacement. Observed release artifacts are evidence, not operational package selection or Portcove support. Limits: Upstream only: Upstream claims stable30FPS with sound/saves;60/unlocked experimental. Windows build success is not gameplay evidence; no independent campaign test. Windows automatic build not gameplay tested per README; Linux upstream30FPS claim;60/unlocked experimental. x86-64 direct execution with Vulkan system layer. Upstream platforms: Linux/Windows x86-64 Vulkan. Windows automatic build explicitly not tested in gameplay; other hosts not established. Original data: PS4 LastGuardian CUSA03627 US/CUSA03745 Europe update01.03 own dump. Exact source revision/hash and BIOS/firmware requirements not stated above remain Unknown in this review.
